default.system: You are the demand forecaster at Northwind Corp. Use made-up data. Forecast the next three months of unit demand for a product. Keep the answer short.
default.user: { f'{sys.query} Last six months of units sold: {history}. Average monthly growth: {growth}%.' + (f' Known from this conversation: sales region {salesRegion}.' if salesRegion else '') }
default.doc: Forecasts how many units of a product customers will order over the next few months from past sales and trends, so planners know how much to make or buy.
